user.title: Add a Radiant Wi-Fi thermostat
user.description: Enter the thermostat's IP address on your network (reserve it in your router so it doesn't change). Everything - status and on/off - works over your local network; no cloud account is needed.

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach a Gizwits thermostat at that address. Check the IP, that the phone app is closed, and that the thermostat is online.

abort.already_configured: This thermostat is already configured (its IP address was updated).

init.title: Radiant thermostat options
init.description: Status changes normally arrive instantly over the local network. This sets the safety-net polling interval.

send_raw.name: Send raw command (local, advanced)
send_raw.description: Advanced/diagnostic: send a raw 0x93 sub-command to the thermostat over the local network and log its reply. A wrong payload may change thermostat settings - only use bytes you have verified from a real capture.

hex.name: Sub-command bytes (hex)
hex.description: The bytes that follow the sequence number, e.g. '05 0a 01' for ON.
